assertion: The State of Palestine grid factor in this workbook is the arithmetic mean of the factors for Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, the Syrian Arab Republic and Turkey.

instrument.name: the five neighbour cells recomputed and compared to Electricity, heat, cooling!B296

error.magnitude: 1.1e-16 absolute, the difference between the recomputed mean and the cell; float round-off

conditions.name: file
conditions.value: UNFCCC GHG emissions calculator ver01.1, md5 57d3ffd78a9f5f9980e15feb65f8d986

conditions.name: the five
conditions.value: Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Syrian Arab Republic, Turkey, as named at Info and sources!E10

domain_of_validity.outside_this: UNTESTED, and the claim is about the arithmetic only. Whether the mean of those five is an estimate of Palestine's grid is a different claim with a different instrument, and this record makes none.

neglected_term.name: resemblance of the five neighbours to the target
neglected_term.held_fixed: that a country's grid factor is estimated by the mean of five neighbours

time_constant.why: never measured. The workbook states the substitution at Info and sources!E10 and gives no basis for it, so there is no measured rate at which the resemblance decays and none can be derived from the file.

rate_ceiling.why: follows the time constant: with no measured rate there is no ceiling to compare it to

coupling.basis: measured by perturbation on the neighbouring Iraq cell under the same case; the Palestine row is consumed by the same lookup and carries the same elasticity to the reported total

collapse_record.why: the workbook states the substitution at Info and sources!E10 and the cell reproduces the unweighted mean to 1.1e-16
